note: Each component gets its own 2021 addition; the blank row stays as evidence. The issue_refs projection comes from the scope naming test: a remainder whose occurrences all state no physical column is one warning (not an identity error) citing exactly those original rows, here the literal-blank 2021 member (CVID 30 in the fixture). From the unknown-column test, its refusal twin: an unnamed variable whose occurrences mix a stated-absent column (CVID 40) with an unknown one (CVID 41) keeps the one unresolved_catalog_identity error, citing both rows, and gets no omitted_columnless_occurrence warning.
fails_if: the `[[errata.delivered]]` compile stops recognising reviewed simultaneous partition components (`component_base_key` stays None), so each entry rewrites the one 2021 blank row instead of keeping it as evidence and adding its own occurrence; or `resolve_source_scope` stops special-casing an all-columnless remainder (the omitted_columnless_occurrence branch), so CVID 30 is reported as an unresolved_catalog_identity error; or that branch tests `any` occurrence (or skips unknown columns) instead of requiring every occurrence to state a negative column, so variable 6 is downgraded to an omitted_columnless_occurrence warning

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers A, B and C in 2020 (CVIDs 20-22), and one literal blank member in 2021 (CVID 30). Unnamed variable 6 delivers a literal blank member in 2020 (CVID 40) and a whitespace-only Kolumnnamn in 2021 (CVID 41), which is not literally blank, so its column is unknown rather than absent.
